title: Serverless Photo Gallery
description: A serverless photo gallery to upload and view images using cloud storage.
fulldescription: This prototype launches a personal photo gallery application. It uses Amazon S3 to securely store your images and host the website interface. AWS Lambda functions manage the backend logic, generating secure temporary links (presigned URLs) so you can upload and view private photos without making the bucket public. Amazon API Gateway sits in front of the logic to handle web requests. It demonstrates the core pattern of handling file uploads and downloads in a cloud-native way.

services.name: S3
services.desc: Stores the uploaded photos and the web interface files.

services.name: AWS Lambda
services.desc: Runs the code to generate secure upload links and list your photos.

services.name: Amazon API Gateway
services.desc: Provides the API endpoints for the frontend to communicate with the backend.

services.name: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
services.desc: Manages security permissions to allow the functions to access specific buckets.
